_comment: Single source of truth for the model lineups: i9 (ik_llama, llm/i9/*.sh), ProBook (mainline llama.cpp, llm/probook/*.ps1) and Mac (Ollama models, llm/mac/*.sh). Each script reads this instead of keeping its own list. Edit this file to add/change a model; do not hardcode one in a script. Retired ProBook modes stay as a comment block in llm/probook/start-llm.ps1 (recipe to restore, not live data). A private lineup goes in llm/models.local.json (gitignored, see models.local.json.example).

_fields.id: THE model name, one per model and used everywhere: agents (OpenCode, Pi, Claude Code, Docker Agent), llama-swap's model page and its stats. Scheme: <model>-<quant>-<publisher>[-MTP]-<context>K. Context = the ctx below; MTP = speculative decoding on.
_fields.desc: Human-readable label, shown in the interactive menu
_fields.file: Local GGUF filename (i9: also the start.sh mode name, without .gguf)
_fields.cram: Prompt-cache RAM limit (MB) passed to -cram (ik_llama.cpp only; ignored by mainline llama.cpp)
_fields.yarn: Apply the machine's YARN rope-scaling flags
_fields.sample: Apply the machine's SAMPLE_BASE sampling flags (--temp/--top-p/--top-k)
_fields.spec: Raw --spec-type speculative-decoding flags, or null (honoured on every machine, ProBook included)
_fields.chat_template: Needs llm/shared/qwen3-template.j2 (models whose built-in template doesn't handle tool calling well)
_fields.mmproj: Vision projector: {file, repo, repo_file, bytes} or null. repo_file is the filename on HuggingFace when it differs from the local file name.
_fields.download: {repo, repo_file, bytes} for download-models.sh. bytes is null where the exact size hasn't been pinned (not verified on download).
_fields.engine: probook only: 'mainline' or 'ik_llama' -- start-llm.ps1 runs both engines on that machine and the mode table has to say which
_fields.short: probook only: the mode name for start-llm.ps1 (e.g. 'qwen36_35b_ml'); not used by agents or llama-swap
_fields.mac: mac entries are Ollama models: id (what agents and llama-swap use), ollama (the Ollama model name), source (what `ollama pull` fetched), ctx

i9.desc: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MTP UD-Q6_K (speculative: suffix + MTP, ~2x on edits)
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MTP UD-Q5_K_XL, 256K ctx (dynamic quant, matches a colleague's setup; unverified quality vs Q6_K)

probook.desc: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B IQ4_NL (bartowski, vanilla) on mainline, draft-mtp from its embedded MTP layers

mac.desc: 13 GB, fully on the M4 GPU, ~31 tok/s; a 4-bit quant does not fit 24 GB (docs/mac.md)
